verdict.rationale: Sumsub exposes a REST API for core verification flows (processing applicants/documents, webhooks, AML screening) and even an MCP server for agent-driven operations, showing strong API coverage of the verification workflow. However, several UI-configured capabilities (team member access management, branding/styles, security-key/biometric account settings) are documented only as console actions with no evidence of equivalent API endpoints, and no public OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (probe returned 404s), so full UI-API parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: API/CLI equivalents for team access management, branding customization, and security settings; a public API reference confirming full endpoint coverage.
